description: ARQ data to a peer recorded Ed3 keeps the maximum segment size, so a D_PDU straddles a block boundary, and the spare space gets no PADDING.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. At 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with Ed4 clear, so it is recorded Ed3 (B-0228, B-0408); our accept, Ed4 clear, goes out at 52000 and the link is made with the 8-bit family when it ends at 57550 (B-0232). At 61500 the client sends 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.' (44 bytes, TTL 0) to SAP 5; the soft link exists, so it goes down at once as a 50-byte ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd starts. The channel has been idle since our own transmission: LBT_WAIT with lbt_wait_vdcd_ms 3000 (K-0074), then contention 12000 ms (second draw). At 76500 the C_PDU is cut at dts.max_segment_size into 20, 20 and 10 bytes (C-0505, C-0508), sent as ED3-DATA-ONLY (type 0) FSNs 0, 1 and 2 (C-0190, C-0730), all with DELIVER IN ORDER, C_PDU START on FSN 0 and END on FSN 2, TX WIN LWE on FSN 0 and TX WIN UWE on FSN 2. The peer is recorded Ed3, so neither short non-final segments nor block alignment are used (C-0554, C-0870, C-1155): the second D_PDU, bytes 38 to 75, straddles the block boundary at byte 64, where towards an Ed4 peer its segment would have been cut to 8 bytes to end there (as in dts-tx/block-align-ed4). 38 + 38 + 28 = 104 bytes, 2 blocks, 10350 ms; EOT 20, 20, 10. The 24 spare bytes would hold two PADDING D_PDUs, but none goes to an Ed3 peer (C-0367, C-0055, C-1154), and there is no acknowledgement to repeat, so they are zero filled. dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts when the transmission ends at 86850. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 64 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133): a type 0 is 18 bytes plus its segment, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4: contention waits 45000, 12000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
